name: Andaz Dubai The Palm
positioning: Andaz lifestyle hotel on the trunk of Palm Jumeirah, set along Palm East Beach, with a design that draws on the sights, scents and textures of Dubai
best_for: Travelers who want a beachfront base on Palm Jumeirah
Families who want a Family Suite
Couples who want an adults' rooftop pool with Burj Al Arab views

facts.text: The hotel is a lifestyle hotel on the trunk of Palm Jumeirah.
The hotel's design weaves in the sights, scents and textures of Dubai.
The Cabana Pool has views of the Burj Al Arab.
The Cabana Pool is decorated with bold, colorful tiles.
The hotel has an infinity pool.
The hotel's spa is ORA Spa.
Guest rooms have a marble bathroom with a deep soaking tub.
The Terrace Suite has a large terrace with multiple seating areas overlooking the city skyline.
The Two Bedroom Royal Suite has a fully equipped kitchen, a jetted tub and a balcony.
The Prince Suite has views of the Dubai skyline from floor-to-ceiling windows.
La Coco Social is a laid-back kitchen, bar and lounge by the beach where all ages come together.

highlights.text: The hotel is set along Palm East Beach.
Asia Asia is a rooftop restaurant and bar with 360-degree views of The Palm, Burj Al Arab and Atlantis.
The Cabana Pool, on the 14th floor, is reserved for adults.
Sea-view rooms look over The Palm's shoreline from floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Junior Suite with balcony has two balconies to enjoy the sunrise.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at Andaz Dubai The Palm.
Dubai International Airport is approximately 30 minutes away by taxi.
WhataHotel notes that the hotel is on a man-made island, so mainland attractions require transportation.
